title: Suggest hashtags from X by mining tags that co-occur with a Story's topic
description: Recent search for the Story's keywords with has:hashtags, entities and public_metrics, max 100 posts; count tags by posts, distinct authors and engagement per impression; drop our existing, generic and single-author tags; check the top few with counts/recent. About $0.55-$1.10 per Story. Tags must be relevant to the Story (no trend riding).
